title: glottogenera: genera defined by a divergence threshold on a language tree, with a release for Glottolog 5.3
description: Genera defined by an explicit rule: on a rooted language tree, a genus is the largest clade whose divergence does not exceed a threshold delta. The rule applies to any tree (an expert classification, or one estimated from data by neighbour-joining, UPGMA or Bayesian inference) and any divergence (a distance between languages averaged over pairs on different branches, or a quantity of the clade such as its age); the package's glottogenera.tree module implements it. The release instantiates it for the 7,674 in-scope languages of Glottolog 5.3, with divergence measured by PMI alignment over the 40-concept ASJP wordlists and delta calibrated against the WALS genera averaged over language families: 1,190 genera, each a complete Glottolog clade, with crown divergence, margins and bootstrap stability. Includes the released tables (also as a CLDF StructureDataset), the full pipeline (Python package with CLI), the vendored Glottolog dump and a web explorer (https://glottogenera.tresoldi.org). The data are under CC BY 4.0, the code under the MIT license.
